name: Asleep
description:
A creature that is {{endormi}} falls unconscious: it is {{a-terre}} and cannot take any {{action}}, {{action-bonus}} or {{reaction}}.

The state ends when the Skill that put it to sleep ends, when the creature takes damage, or when another creature spends an {{action}} to shake or slap it awake.

An Undead or a Construct cannot fall {{endormi}}.
